findings.description: The KMS customer-managed key omits enable_key_rotation, so it defaults to false and the key material is never automatically rotated. Because this CMK encrypts a logs bucket, a single compromised key version would expose the entire historical log dataset, and the indefinite cryptoperiod conflicts with standard key-management requirements.

deletion_window_in_days is set to 7, the shortest value AWS permits. A principal holding kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion could destroy the key protecting audit logs with only a 7-day window for detection and cancellation, rendering the encrypted logs permanently unreadable and enabling anti-forensic destruction of evidence.
